{"id":1906516103,"question_id":3956,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1770111029,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1906516103/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Trionic Array II","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long maxSumTrionic(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n        ll maxsum = LLONG_MIN;\n\n        vector<ll>cum(n);\n        cum[0] = nums[0];\n        //here is the cummulative sum vector\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<n ; i++) cum[i] = cum[i-1] + nums[i];\n        \n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++)\n        {\n            int j = i;\n            while(j+1 < n and nums[j] < nums[j+1]) j++;\n            int pointP = j;\n            if(pointP == i) continue;\n            \n            while(j+1 < n and nums[j] > nums[j+1]) j++;\n            int pointQ = j;\n            if(pointQ == pointP) continue;\n\n            while(j+1 < n and nums[j] < nums[j+1]) j++;\n            int pointR = j;\n            if(pointR == pointQ) continue;\n\n            //if we get all points then we have to find the sum of the array\n\n            ll sum = cum[pointR] - (i > 0 ? cum[i-1] : 0);\n            maxsum = max<ll>(maxsum , sum);\n        }\n        return maxsum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"trionic-array-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1636}
